title: IMD Heavy to Very Heavy Rainfall Advisory
verification_method: IMD Regional Daily Weather Forecast Bulletin
headline: Isolated heavy to very heavy rainfall expected over Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kanchipuram, and Chengalpattu districts.
advisory_text: Squally weather with wind speeds reaching 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph is likely along and off Tamil Nadu coast. Fishermen are advised not to venture into southwest and adjoining westcentral Bay of Bengal. Low-lying areas may experience temporary waterlogging.
instructions: Avoid unnecessary travel to known low-lying waterlogged arterial roads.
Keep electronic devices and mobile phones fully charged.
Store sufficient drinking water and non-perishable food supplies.
Do not touch electrical poles, transformers, or submerged wires.
disclaimer: Official bulletin archive. If live weather changes rapidly, tune in to All India Radio or official TNSDMA updates.

title: Greater Chennai Corporation Monsoon Preparedness & Pumping Operations
source_organization: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) Disaster Management Cell
verification_method: GCC Official Public Health & Engineering Department Circular
headline: GCC deploys 900+ high-power dewatering pumps across 15 zones.
advisory_text: Subways and vulnerable underpasses are monitored 24/7 with dedicated motor pumps. GCC Helpline 1913 is operational with 50 lines for waterlogging complaints.
instructions: Report blocked storm water drains or water stagnation directly via toll-free 1913.
Refrain from opening sewer manholes manually to avoid fatal suction hazards.
disclaimer: Verified official administrative notice from Greater Chennai Corporation.

title: Water Resources Department (WRD) Reservoir Storage Watch
source_organization: Tamil Nadu Water Resources Department (WRD) - Chennai Region
verification_method: Daily Reservoir Water Level & Inflow Report
headline: Poondi, Chembarambakkam, Red Hills, and Cholavaram reservoirs at stable holding capacity.
advisory_text: Chembarambakkam is at 68% capacity; Adyar river course currently safe. Controlled buffer releases will be notified 2 hours in advance to riverside communities.
instructions: Residents living within 100 metres of the Adyar and Cooum river basins should monitor flood sirens and local GCC announcements.
